name: All new services REQUIRE a Security Design Review to ensure security flaws are identified and fixed in the cheapest and easiest stage of the lifecycle.
conditionsText: During the design phase of the project a security design review is required
requirementTitle: All new services REQUIRE a Security Design Review to ensure security flaws are identified and fixed in the cheapest and easiest stage of the lifecycle.
requirementDescription: Before a new service is built or launched, it must undergo a Security Design Review to identify and address security weaknesses early, when they are easier and less expensive to fix.
why: It is much cheaper and safer to identify issues early rather than discovering the problem after the application has gone live and exposed sensitive data.
